# terbium

> An algorithmic parser for business documents that scores its own confidence and escalates only the residue to a model.

Canonical page: https://anishfyi.com/terbium/
Source: https://github.com/anishfyi/terbium
Install: pip install terbium-parse
Version at time of writing: 0.10.0
Author: Anish Kr Singh (anishfyi), https://anishfyi.com/

## What it is

terbium parses PDF, PPTX, XLSX and CSV by rebuilding table structure from the geometry of every word, scores each row 0 to 1, and calls a vision model only for the pages the algorithm cannot resolve.

## Facts

- Parses PDF, PPTX, XLSX and CSV. Vendor catalogues are the flagship; invoices, bills, receipts and resumes run through the same engine.
- Table structure is rebuilt from the geometry of every word on the page rather than from a fixed template.
- Every record is scored 0 to 1 on grid regularity, header presence and fill. Only pages below threshold are escalated to a model tier.
- For catalogues each product photo anchors a row: the image is extracted, named from the label beneath it, and nearby text is mined for the SKU and materials.
- Requires Python 3.9 or newer. MIT licensed. Current version 0.10.0.
- Sponsored by NodeMaven, a disclosed commercial relationship.

## Questions and answers

### What is terbium?

terbium is a Python library that turns business documents into clean, confidence-scored rows. It reconstructs table structure from the geometry of the words on the page, scores its own output, and only reaches for an AI model when the algorithm cannot be sure.

### What file formats does terbium parse?

PDF, PPTX, XLSX and CSV.

### How do I install terbium?

Run `pip install terbium-parse`. The import name is `terbium` and it needs Python 3.9 or newer.

### Does terbium need an AI model to work?

No. The deterministic geometry engine handles clean documents on its own. A model is called only for pages that score below the confidence threshold, which you opt into by passing `ai=terbium.AI()`.

### How does terbium extract a vendor catalogue?

Call `terbium.build_catalog("catalogue.pdf", images_dir="images/")`. Each product photo anchors a row, and terbium fills in the name, SKU and materials from the surrounding text, then `terbium.to_catalog_csv` writes it out.

### How does terbium know when it is wrong?

It scores every record 0 to 1 on grid regularity, header presence and fill, so low-confidence rows are visible rather than silently wrong.
